text.title: Futures jump ahead of Anthropic's record IPO debut; Walmart lifts outlook
text.summary: US stock futures are higher this morning, led by the Nasdaq 100 (+2.1%) and S&P 500 (+1.2%), ahead of Anthropic's trading debut. The Dow fell 1.1% in the last session, but Dow futures are up 0.6%. The 10-year Treasury yield eased 3 bp to 5.07%.

drivers.t: Futures are rising ahead of Anthropic's Nasdaq debut (ticker ANT). The company raised a record $107.3 billion in an upsized IPO and private placement, and gray-market trading points to a jump above 20% at the open.

Barclays says it does not view the AI trade as collapsing, calling the current slowdown a correction that can be selectively bought. Separately, Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress told staff to 'move forward' at her first all-hands since Jensen Huang's exit.

drivers.h: Walmart and Palo Alto raise outlooks
drivers.t: Walmart raised its outlook and its CEO said the retailer aims to keep prices low despite soaring fuel costs. Palo Alto Networks also boosted its outlook, citing the threat environment and demand ahead.
The dollar index is down 0.1% at 103.71 after touching a 19-month high of 103.974 overnight. Deutsche Bank says the currency is likely to stay higher for longer.
WTI is up 1.0% at $83.14. Trump said the US will 'see what happens' in its conflict with Iran after January 1, but the headlines don't tie the oil move directly to a single cause.

earnings.t: Shares are down 1.1% premarket despite the raised outlook, which the company tied to strength in store-fulfilled pickup and delivery.
One report says Alibaba's cloud business is thriving, but its profits are completely offset by losses from its AI labs.
